title: HHS-03: HHS priority letter names jurisdiction-level preparedness capability evidence
summary: GAO identifies collection and analysis of jurisdiction preparedness capabilities and gaps as a current CDC priority action. Phase 56P publishes the letter-named action while preserving its local identity boundary and open-status limit.
key_findings: Exact letter action: HHS-03 — CDC should collect and analyze information on jurisdictions' ability to meet preparedness capabilities and the gaps in their ability to do so.
Status period: Open priority portfolio as of May 2026; letter dated June 3, 2026.
Identity boundary: FTFN key HHS-03 identifies the action text in GAO-26-108997; it is not a GAO Recommendations Database number.
Continuation rule: Recheck the GAO Recommendations Database or the next HHS priority letter for an exact identifier or status change tied to this action.
why_it_matters: The record converts portfolio-level visibility into an inspectable named action without claiming implementation or importing an unsupported database identifier.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves letter, subject, local action key, status period, and continuation identity.
Keeps priority designation, implementation, closure, operating outcome, and realized benefit distinct.
evidence_limits: The letter names the action but does not provide its underlying GAO Recommendations Database number or a complete HHS portfolio inventory.
Open priority designation does not prove non-performance, implementation progress, closure, or operating outcome.
The local action key is an FTFN reference and must not be presented as a GAO-assigned recommendation number.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, value estimate, or causal claim is supported.
